title: EarthwardPartRecord
description: Append-only chain-of-custody record for one physical part instance. Every house agent writes events into this structure via the Traceability Agent. Never mutated in place; corrections are new events referencing the original.

part_id.description: Unique identifier for this physical part instance (not the part number/design).

revision.description: Drawing revision this instance was built to.

current_status.description: Derived from event history, never asserted directly — must be recomputable/auditable at any time.

events.description: Append-only. Never mutated or deleted in place.

id.description: Agent name or human employee ID.

reference.description: Pointer to supporting data: cert number, inspection report ID, NCR ID, sign-off record ID, etc. Never free text standing alone.

corrects_event_id.description: If this is a correction event, the event_id it corrects. Original event is never deleted.

data.description: Event-type-specific payload (measured values, deviation details, NCR summary, etc.)
